art_direction: 浅海沫绿底柔赭双眼，间距舒展，轻轻左望。
composition_variation: Leave a slightly wider gap between the eyes. The left bowl rests lower and about one-fifth less open, while the right has a fuller lower arc. Both dark upper lids curve softly and merge into large black pupils looking gently left. Use identical soft ochre lower bands, tapering naturally at the ends, with one slender elongated ivory glint in each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
